A novel 3D printed cage with microporous structure and in vivo fusion function.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now animal Exp. validation
Peng Li, Wei Jiang, Jia Yan, Kun Hu, Zhenchuan Han et al. Journal of biomedical materials research. Part A 2019-07-01 10.1002/jbm.a.36652
单位: Department of Orthopedics, Chinese PLA General Hospital, Beijing, 100853, China.
通讯: Fuzhai Cui @ Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Tsinghua University, Beijing, 100084, China. [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接采用LPBF制造多孔钛椎间融合器，评估了刚度匹配、力学性能及体内骨整合，完全符合用户对增材制造生物医学材料的研究方向。
边界: Does not report fatigue testing or surface roughness quantification, and lacks comparison of multiple porous designs for stress shielding optimization.
动机· 设计一种刚度与骨匹配的多孔钛椎间融合器以促进骨整合。
方法· 通过LPBF制造八面体多孔钛融合器，并进行力学测试和羊体内植入实验。
结果· 多孔钛融合器的弹性模量和抗压强度接近骨，且3个月时新骨长入孔隙，骨接触率高。
验证· 羊体内植入实验验证了骨整合和生物相容性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To design a porous titanium cage with stiffness matched to bone to enhance osseointegration for spinal fusion.
Method· LPBF was used to fabricate a titanium cage with octahedral pores, followed by mechanical testing and in vivo implantation in sheep.
Result· The porous cage exhibited Young's modulus and compressive strength similar to bone, with new bone ingrowth and high bone contact at 3 months post-implantation.
Validation· In vivo sheep model confirmed osseointegration and biocompatibility.

Gaussian process emulation to accelerate parameter estimation in a mechanical model of the left ventricle: a critical step towards clinical end-user relevance

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Direct Read now simulation_case UQ Patient-specific
Umberto Noè, Alan Lazarus, Hao Gao, Vinny Davies, Benn Macdonald et al. Journal of The Royal Society Interface 2019-07-01 10.1098/rsif.2019.0114
单位: German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE), Bonn, Germany
通讯: Dirk Husmeier @ School of Mathematics and Statistics, University of Glasgow, Glasgow, UK
相关性: 该论文使用高斯过程代理模型加速心脏力学参数估计，方法可直接迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模与不确定性量化。
边界: This paper focuses on cardiac mechanics rather than implant biomechanics, and does not address stress shielding or implant-specific design constraints.
动机· 心脏力学模型参数估计计算成本高，难以用于临床实时决策。
方法· 采用高斯过程统计代理模型替代有限元求解，加速参数推断。
结果· 计算成本降低约三个数量级，精度损失极小。
验证· 基于模拟数据和真实磁共振图像数据对比验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The high computational cost of parameter estimation in cardiac biomechanical models hinders their use in real-time clinical decision support.
Method· A Gaussian process emulator is used to replace finite-element simulations during optimization, accelerating parameter inference.
Result· Computational cost is reduced by approximately three orders of magnitude with negligible loss in accuracy.
Validation· Validation is performed using simulated data from finite-element solutions and real magnetic resonance images from a human volunteer.

A Sum of Squares Optimization Approach to Uncertainty Quantification

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Brendon K. Colbert, Luis G. Crespo, Matthew M. Peet 2019-07-01 10.23919/acc.2019.8814931
单位: Arizona State University, Tempe, AZ, 85287, USA
通讯: Brendon K. Colbert @ Arizona State University, Tempe, AZ, 85287, USA
相关性: 该论文提出的SOS优化方法可用于非高斯分布的不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物设计中的鲁棒优化问题。
边界: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on general uncertainty quantification without integration with simulation or optimization loops.
动机· 针对非高斯过程的不确定性量化问题，提出基于SOS优化的概率密度估计方法。
方法· 通过多项式映射将数据提升至高维空间，拟合最优高斯分布后投影回物理空间得到切片正态分布。
结果· 切片正态分布能刻画多模态响应和强参数依赖，构建的置信区域可靠。
验证· 数值算例验证了方法的可靠性和有效性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantify uncertainty in non-Gaussian processes, this work proposes a sum-of-squares optimization approach for density estimation.
Method· A polynomial map lifts data to a higher-dimensional space, where an optimal Gaussian fit is found and then projected back to physical space via a polynomial slice, yielding a Sliced Normal distribution.
Result· The Sliced Normal distribution captures multimodal responses and strong parameter dependencies, and the constructed confidence regions are reliable.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks demonstrate the reliability and effectiveness of the proposed method.

Motivation· To quantify the impact of epistemic uncertainties from electrode implantation on neural activation in rodent deep brain stimulation.

Result· Encapsulation layer thickness and implantation precision significantly affect axonal activation within the targeted nucleus.
Validation· The method is validated through simulation cases demonstrating the efficiency and accuracy of the uncertainty quantification.

通讯: Issam Laradji @ Dept. of Computer Science, University of British Columbia, Vancouver, Canada
相关性: 该论文提出的GP-DRF模型能够处理变长输入并量化不确定性，可迁移至生物力学代理建模中的多尺度或序列输入问题。
边界: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or any biomedical/mechanical engineering context.
动机· 现有深度高斯过程无法处理变长输入且扩展性差。
方法· 提出GP-DRF模型，结合高斯过程与深度随机特征层，实现变长输入下的高效推理。
结果· GP-DRF在多个数据集上优于标准GP和DRF，且不确定性量化更准确。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Deep Gaussian processes struggle with variable-sized inputs and scalability, limiting their application to structured data like trees and sequences.
Method· The GP-DRF model combines a GP input layer with deep random feature layers, enabling tractable inference for variable-sized inputs while learning long-range dependencies.
Result· GP-DRF outperforms standard GP and DRF models on multiple datasets, with improved uncertainty quantification measured by Bhattacharyya distance.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks on standard machine learning datasets demonstrate the model's effectiveness.

相关性: 该论文关注髋臼重建的临床结果，而非股骨柄或近端股骨的生物力学分析。
边界: No quantification of proximal femur stress/strain or micromotion; no contact/friction modeling; no intact vs implanted femur comparison.
动机· 评估Kerboull型髋臼加强环在初次和翻修THA中的失败风险因素。
方法· 回顾性病例对照研究，分析60例患者的影像学和临床数据。
结果· 碎骨移植和高髋中心型KT是手术不良预后的独立风险因素。
验证· 基于至少4年随访的临床和影像学评估。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To identify risk factors for poor outcomes of acetabular reconstruction using Kerboull-type reinforcement rings in primary and revision THA.
Method· A retrospective case-control study of 60 patients with severe acetabular bone loss treated with allogenic bone graft and KT rings, analyzing clinical and radiographic data.
Result· Morselized bone graft and high hip center-type KT were independent risk factors for radiological failure.
Validation· Clinical and radiographic evaluation with minimum 4-year follow-up.

动机· 评估现有髋关节假体尺寸是否适合巴西人群。
方法· 回顾性分析682例初次全髋置换术的假体尺寸使用分布。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine whether currently available hip implant sizes match the anthropometric profile of the Brazilian population.
Method· A retrospective study analyzed the size distribution of 682 primary THA cases using eight implant models.
Result· Five of eight models showed adequate sizing, while three models were predominantly used in their smallest size, indicating insufficient size options.
Validation· Clinical data distribution analysis (non-Gaussian curve assessment).

方法· 使用股骨模型进行横向、斜向和阶梯截骨，并在不同位置固定植骨块进行力学测试。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the biomechanical stability of different subtrochanteric osteotomy types and graft positions in total hip arthroplasty with shortening osteotomy.
Method· Composite femur sawbones were used to compare transverse, oblique, and step-cut osteotomies with strut grafts fixed in anterolateral, mediolateral, and anteroposterior positions, and failure loads were recorded under axial and rotational loading.
Result· No statistically significant differences in failure values were found among osteotomy types or graft positions.
Validation· Mechanical testing on composite femurs provided experimental validation.

动机· 预测THR骨水泥中裂纹的萌生和扩展路径。
方法· 使用扩展有限元法(XFEM)模拟裂纹从椭球形空腔边缘萌生。
结果· 裂纹仅在长短轴比为0.1的空腔锐边萌生，最大长度19微米。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To predict crack initiation and propagation in orthopedic cement of total hip arthroplasty using XFEM.
Method· Extended Finite Element Method (XFEM) was employed to simulate crack initiation from ellipsoidal cavities with varying aspect ratios.
Result· Cracks initiated only from sharp edges of cavities with minor-to-major axis ratio of 0.1, reaching a maximum length of 19 μm under static loading.
Validation· Numerical simulation only; no experimental validation was performed.

Motivation· To develop a reproducible and inexpensive small animal model for quantitative preclinical screening of implant osseointegration.
Method· Custom-made parallel-walled titanium implants were inserted into rat tail vertebrae using a surgical guide, and osseointegration was evaluated by axial pull-out test, resonance frequency analysis, histomorphometry, and micro-CT over 4–16 weeks.
Result· The pull-out test showed higher sensitivity (approximately fivefold increase) and lower standard error than resonance frequency analysis, while histomorphometry provided more reliable bone-implant contact data than micro-CT.
Validation· The model was validated in vivo using Wistar rats, with biomechanical and structural tests confirming time-dependent osseointegration.

Motivation· To investigate the effects of local strontium release on adipogenesis and osseointegration in aged bone for dental implant applications.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the efficiency and temperature changes during Er:YAG laser-assisted removal of lithium disilicate crowns from titanium implant abutments.
Method· Forty identical crowns were cemented with two luting agents, and Er:YAG laser was applied; removal time and temperature at the abutment and crown were recorded.
Result· Removal was faster with resin-modified glass ionomer cement; temperature rises were not high enough to jeopardize osseointegration, and no surface damage was observed.
Validation· In vitro temperature measurement and SEM surface examination validated the results.

Motivation· To investigate the mechanism by which excessive fluoride exposure impairs osseointegration between titanium implants and osteoblasts.
Method· In vitro cell assays with cp-Ti samples exposed to NaF and in vivo fluorosis mouse model, combined with Western blot analysis of Hippo/YAP and MAPK pathways.
Result· High fluoride (1.0 mM NaF) disrupted titanium passivation, inhibited osteoblast adhesion and viability, upregulated apoptosis, and activated MAPK and YAP signaling via JNK-mediated YAP phosphorylation.
Validation· Validation through laser scanning microscopy, CCK-8 assay, flow cytometry, Western blot, and histological examination of mouse bone tissue.

Motivation· To identify predictors of clinical failure and inferior outcomes after hip arthroscopy for femoroacetabular impingement syndrome using modern surgical techniques.
Method· Prospective data from 949 patients were analyzed with stepwise linear regression to determine patient-related and imaging-related predictors.
Result· The clinical failure rate was 2.2%; predictors included poor articular cartilage, hypertension, and prolonged symptom duration.
Validation· Validation was based on a minimum two-year follow-up of patient-reported outcomes in a prospective cohort.

Motivation· To compare functional outcomes and complications of different surgical treatments for femoral neck fractures in elderly patients.
Method· A prospective observational study of 50 elderly patients treated with internal fixation, hemiarthroplasty, or total hip arthroplasty.
Result· Arthroplasty yielded superior functional outcomes (mean HHS 81.5) compared to internal fixation (mean HHS 68.4), with an overall complication rate of 18%.
Validation· Clinical follow-up at 12 months using Harris Hip Score.

Motivation· To evaluate the surgical technique and clinical outcomes of the direct posterior approach for posterior acetabular fractures.
Method· A retrospective analysis of 10 patients with posterior acetabular fractures treated via the direct posterior approach, assessing operative parameters and functional recovery.
Result· The approach yielded an average operation time of 50 min, blood loss of 310 ml, and an excellent-to-good rate of 80% with no major complications.
Validation· Clinical outcomes were validated through postoperative radiography, CT, and the Merle d'Aubigne-Postel score.
